correctness.rationale: Explicit coordinate reduction for every real target yields N=1+2 times the number of positive roots of mu_x(y)=M-1. Verified differentiation gives g_y=(8/pi)Re[z/(1-z^4)] and Im p'(z)=(5-2 Re z^4-3|z|^8) Im z^4/|1-z^4|^4; its sign implies mu has at most one interior maximum. The exact endpoint derivative g_y(sqrt(1-x^2))=2/(pi x) sets xc=2/sqrt(pi^2+4). At and below mc, mu is one-crossing and explicit endpoint ratio <1 supplies three distinct preimages. Above mc, endpoint-to-peak perturbations supply two distinct positive heights and thus five preimages. Independent script witnesses M=1.9,2,4 and checks selected below-threshold slices. No finite experiment is used as proof of the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: A complete all-parameter sharp classification of a natural geometric invariant (the maximal multiplicity of real fibers) for the canonical 2026 harmonic Landau counterexample. Establishes a global at-most-five theorem and a concrete sharp bifurcation at 1+pi/sqrt(pi²+4), far below source’s M* for the classical Landau radius. It resolves a motivated inversion and fold-multiplicity question not settled by a single Jacobian zero, so value does not rest on computation, renaming or an arbitrary parameter slice.
